access_note: Only provider metadata and documentation were read. Files, models and software were not downloaded or executed.
description: The provider identifies monthly water-demand observations for Kuwait. They can support demand forecasting and water-supply planning at national scale. This resource is provided by Abdullah Alsumaiei. Coverage is national as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: CC BY 4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The landing-page description does not establish the observation years, variable definitions or maintenance. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-epanet. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
